response.overview: Over the course of one day, teenage girl ANDIE, who transforms herself for every girl she meets—carefully curating mood boards, mannerisms, and borrowed personas in her desperate search for love and a self of her own. But when her carefully constructed identities begin to unravel alongside her dangerous relationship with her sugar daddy, ANDIE is forced to confront the one question she has spent all day avoiding: kung sino ba siya, girl?
response.tagline: ALAM MO BA GIRL, KUNG SINO KA?
response.title: ALAM MO BA GIRL?
